primary_validity_definition: Input/source/metric integrity and all32 NPUs active for the complete [2000,4000)ms. Old warmup, mixed roles and nominal capacity are diagnostics and never used to exclude a seed.

metadata.label: raw84_uniform_seed7
metadata.old_validity_caveat: Do not reject/retry runs for failure of original fourth-completion warmup, per-card mixed roles, per-SSD nominal capacity or individual link feasibility. Report these independently.
metadata.physical_volume_rule: Original data C and V retained in load; each raw64 tail of 88KiB occupies a full 176KiB physical command, so 88KiB extra per layer for NQL64 only. Actual placement defines physical traffic.
metadata.role_definition: short means seq_len_k<=80; long means seq_len_k>80. These are sequence-length labels, not measured compute duration; inspect all four categories.
metadata.sampling: Each NPU uses random.Random(seed+100003*npu), sorted catalog, independent uniform randrange with replacement, stopping only at declared pure-compute budget.
metadata.sampling_caveat: No fixed warmup profiles, seed retries, compute scaling or repeating decks. Stop-dependent terminal request lies after warm window even under pure-compute execution.
metadata.stripe_rule: ssu=(block_index+npu_id//4)%6; same exact placement under both strategies

static_max_proof.definition: For each SSU sum over NPUs the maximum 1000*actual_layer_V/C among every request and layer on that original NPU.
static_max_proof.scope: Upper bound on nominal current admitted-request V/C; not a released-I/O or FIFO deadline guarantee; assumes original NPU assignment.
